newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Advance Synergy to requote on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Advance Synergy to requote on Thursday.

text.p: The stock of Malaysia's Advance Synergy Bhd (ASB) will be requoted on Thursday, a statement by the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said on Monday.
The stock of the property and timber products firm was suspended since April 25 pending a restructuring of its financial services arm, United Merchant Group Bhd.
Advance stock was last traded at 3.28 ringgit.
The company said in a statement on Saturday that it has received regulatory approval to sell its entire 50.75 percent interest in United Merchant to its existing shareholders.
The proposed sale is conditional on Advance Synergy chairman Ahmad Sebi Bakar retaining a personal 30 percent stake in Malpac Holdings Bhd.
United Merchant had announced that it was proposing to buy a 33 percent stake in Malpac.
